raw.query: WITH ledger AS (SELECT n_images, MIN(total_kernel_ms) AS total_kernel_ms, SUM(ms) FILTER (WHERE entry_kind = 'category') AS attributed_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE entry_kind = 'category') AS attributed_terms FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger GROUP BY n_images), current_validation AS (SELECT sla_metric, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src') SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n_images', n_images, 'total_kernel_ms', total_kernel_ms, 'attributed_ms', attributed_ms, 'remainder_ms', total_kernel_ms - attributed_ms, 'attributed_terms', attributed_terms) ORDER BY n_images) FROM ledger) AS per_batch_ledger, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger) AS ledger_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT n_images) FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger) AS batch_denominator, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(current_validation) ORDER BY sla_metric) FROM current_validation) AS current_validation
raw.observed: Across both ledger batches, N=1 has total 9.542 ms, attributed 9.541999999999998 ms, remainder 1.7763568394002505e-15 ms; N=64 has total 498.267 ms, attributed 498.268 ms, remainder -0.0009999999999763531 ms. Each has 7 attributed terms.
